title: Diagnostic task-sensitivity & robustness harness for low-precision rollouts
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Purpose: Build a diagnostic evaluation harness and composite metric suite to assess the real-world accuracy impact of FP8/INT8 rollouts across task families. Goal is to enable deterministic gating decisions for rollouts (canary, gradual, rollback) that combine statistical significance with task-sensitive tolerances. This ticket scopes the metric definitions, integration points with the eval runner, and the initial dashboard and alerting signals.

Why: Existing pipelines report isolated metrics (perplexity, MMLU accuracy, ROUGE/BLEU) but we lack a single, explainable signal that (a) aggregates cross-task degradation, (b) highlights worst-case task regressions, and (c) surfaces where calibration (per-layer scaling / KL re-run) is most effective. This harness will also provide per-batch and per-token diagnostics to guide calibration iterations and fallback logic at serving time.
approach:
1) Define a Robustness-Aware Composite Metric (RACM): RACM = weighted_sum(Delta_MMLU_acc_norm, Relative_ROUGE_drop, BLEU_drop_norm, Perplexity_ratio_log, WorstTaskPercentilePenalty) where weights are configurable per-customer/workload. Include a task-importance multiplier for labeled critical tasks.

2) Task-specific scorers:
- Instruction Fidelity Score: pass/fail for instruction-following by checking expected function/slot outputs and semantic similarity (embedding cosine + syntactic checks).
- Extractive QA Delta: F1 drop relative to FP32 baseline with bootstrap CI.
- Summarization Fidelity: ROUGE-L relative drop plus a semantic-embedding delta filter.
- Code Gen Signal: heuristics combining compile/pass@k simulation for small functions and AST-based similarity.
- MMLU-style Core Suite: report both absolute accuracy and percentile shifts across subjects.
- Perplexity Ratio: median(token-level PPL_{low-prec} / PPL_{fp32}) and tail-percentiles (99th) to detect catastrophic token collapse.

3) Statistical rigor: use bootstrap resampling to compute 95% CI for each Delta; run N=1000 bootstrap iterations for non-parametric tasks. Use Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across test batteries to reduce false positives when evaluating many tasks.

4) Acceptance gating rules (configurable): e.g., RACM increase <= 0.02 OR per-task drop <= 1.5% absolute with non-overlapping CI; if any critical task fails, mark rollout FAIL and trigger automatic fallback policy.
calibration_workflow:
Step A - Data stratification: Partition eval sets into workload strata (dialogue, summarization, QA, code, classification) and annotate exemplar difficulty/length buckets.
Step B - Activation histograms: Collect per-layer activation/weight distributions during FP32 inference across shards; persist histograms to S3 for quant config generation.
Step C - Per-token KL sweep: Run KL divergence scans over representative prefixes to find per-layer scale factors and candidates for per-channel clipping.
Step D - Candidate profile generation: Generate a small set (3-5) candidate quant profiles per model (aggressive, balanced, conservative) and tag with expected throughput gains.
Step E - Batch eval: Run candidates across stratified eval sets, compute RACM and task scorers, and capture token-level PPL ratios and worst-case examples.
Step F - Human-in-the-loop review: For failing or borderline candidates, auto-collect top N failure examples and attach to PR for SME review.
Step G - Rollout policy attach: For accepted candidates, produce rollout config with gating thresholds and fallback model mapping (e.g., route rare long-context requests to conservative profile or FP32).
evaluation_harness_changes:
- New runner mode: 'sensitivity-diagnostic' that executes stratified runs, records per-example metadata (seed, difficulty, length), and emits both aggregated metrics and per-example failure traces.
- Metric modules: implement RACM aggregator, task-specific scorer adapters (instruction_fidelity, code_sim, extractive_f1_adapter).
- CI integrations: lightweight smoke test that runs a subset of tasks on PRs for quant profile commits.
- Reporting: add CSV/Parquet exports with token-level PPL ratios and per-layer histogram references for postmortem.
- Performance: parallelize eval shards across spot GPU pools and add checkpointing to resume long runs.
instrumentation_and_dashboards:
- Dashboard tiles: RACM trend across profiles, per-task delta heatmap, 95% CI ribbons, token-level PPL tail tracker, top failing examples with links to model-run artifacts.
- Alerts: trigger when RACM breaches soft threshold (warning) or hard threshold (failure) for a release.
- Debug views: per-layer activation histogram explorer and per-prefix KL surface plot to guide retraining or per-channel calibration.
- Links: each failing example links to a GH PR template auto-populated with model, profile, inputs, outputs, and suggested fallback.
acceptance_criteria: RACM implemented as a pluggable metric in the eval runner and returns consistent values against synthetic baselines
At least five task-specific scorer adapters implemented and unit-tested (instruction fidelity, extractive QA, summarization, code, MMLU)
Bootstrap CI and FDR correction implemented and validated on a held-out suite
Dashboard tiles render RACM and per-task heatmap with example links
A CI smoke test runs on PRs and blocks merges if a quant-profile change causes RACM to exceed the soft threshold
